title: Counit-normalized target comparison for reconstructed unit purity
statement: Fix the finite-field datum D, coefficient datum C, finite intermediate coefficient field E, a smooth separated finite-type morphism f:X→Y of pure relative dimension d between separated finite-type schemes over D.k, and an actual coefficient-compatible exceptional RingSystem S. There exists a FiniteRightNormalization normal for S and, for every uniform finite-Tor integral object K on Y, an isomorphism e from the actual exceptional inverse-limit object purAdicTarget(K) to the underlying object of S.G(K). For every positive exponent n+1, reduction of e followed by targetReduction(normal,K,n) is the published exceptional tower reduction purAdicTargetReduction(K,n), as heterogeneous equality of the finite coefficient morphisms. This is only a target-coordinate comparison; it constructs neither a purity map nor a trace.

proof.text: Restrict the actual integral support/exceptional adjunction to the uniform finite-Tor categories. Transport its left adjoint along S.left. The counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison identifies the actual exceptional inverse-limit object with S.G(K).

At each finite level compare the specified restricted adjunction with the intrinsic finite exceptional adjunction, using finiteImageIso and the same left realization. Right-adjoint uniqueness gives normal.iso and its counit equation gives normal.counit. Unlike bare S.finiteRight, this construction fixes the finite counit normalization.

Reduce the integral comparison. Its composite with the counit-normalized finite right comparison and the exceptional towers published evaluation map are mates of the same compact-support reduction map. Insert the counit equations, use naturality of support reduction and the adjunction triangle, and apply injectivity of the finite exceptional Hom bijection. This gives the displayed target-reduction equation for each K and exponent.

theorem unit_trace_target_normalization :
    ∃ normal : FiniteRightNormalization D C E f S,
      ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory C.l E Y,
        ∃ e : purAdicTarget D C E f K.obj ≅ ((operation D C E f S).G.obj K).obj,
          ∀ n : ℕ, HEq
            ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension C.l E X n).map e.hom ≫
              targetReduction D C E f S normal K n)
            (purAdicTargetReduction D C E f d K.obj K.property n)
